<div class="wrap">

<header class="pagehead">

  <h1>Programme</h1>
  <p class="lead">II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics. All sessions took place in Aula F1.2 of the LPC Campus, CUNEF Universidad, unless otherwise noted.</p>
</header>

<section class="section">
  <div class="layout">

    </dl>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section">

      <p class="slot__kind">Keynote 1</p>
      <span class="slot__title">Peter Müller</span>
      <p class="slot__sub">A semi-parametric Bayesian GLM and applications to outcome dependent sampling</p>
    </div></div>

      <p class="slot__kind">Keynote 2</p>
      <span class="slot__title">David Rossell</span>
      <p class="slot__sub">High-dimensional model selection: transfer learning and projected computation</p>
    </div></div>

    <div class="slot slot--minor"><time>11:15–11:45</time><div><span class="slot__title">Coffee break</span></div></div>

    <div class="slot"><time>11:45–13:05</time><div>
      <p class="slot__kind">Contributed session I</p>

        <li><time>12:25</time><span><b>María F. Pintado</b> — Bayesian Markov-Switching Partial Reduced-Rank Regression</span></li>
        <li><time>12:45</time><span><b>Juan Ballesteros-Gómez</b> — Bayesian Extreme Value Theory with Hawkes-AR-Gumbel Dependence for Extreme CVaR Estimation in Operational Risk</span></li>

      <span class="slot__title">Model Selection</span>
      <ol class="talks">
        <li><time>14:35</time><span><b>Lorenzo Capello</b> — Bayesian Model Checks and Improvements for Discrete Data</span></li>

        <li><time>15:15</time><span><b>Carlos García Meixide</b> — Shrinkage through multiple identifiability</span></li>
      </ol>

      <p class="slot__kind">Keynote 3</p>
      <span class="slot__title">Stefano Cabras</span>
      <p class="slot__sub">Objective Bayesian Model Uncertainty Quantification under Missing Data</p>
    </div></div>

    <div class="slot"><time>17:05–18:05</time><div>
      <p class="slot__kind">Contributed session III</p>
      <span class="slot__title">Applied Bayesian Methods</span>

        <li><time>17:05</time><span><b>Yago Aguado-Carrillo-de-Albornoz</b> — Information-based Bayesian Optimization with Expert Human Feedback</span></li>
        <li><time>17:25</time><span><b>Adam Olivares</b> — Applied Bayesian nonparametric modeling under likelihood ratio order constraints</span></li>
        <li><time>17:45</time><span><b>Miguel Franco Pérez</b> — Latent advertising stock and saturation for Marketing Mix Modeling: a field for Bayesian methods' expansion</span></li>
